name: Test a Secret
description: Tries a secret from the Secrets Store against its real service and shows what came back: a reply from an AI model, a live share price, the latest US inflation figure, your Paperless library, your Gitea repos, or a test notification on your phone. Pick one secret, or all that are set. Keys are never shown. Every secret in the default list has a test here.

parameters.name: Secret
parameters.default: all | All secrets that are set
parameters.description: Which secret to test. The list comes from the script, so it always matches the tests.

parameters.name: Stock symbol
parameters.description: Finance tests: the share to look up (EOD adds .US if you leave off the exchange)

parameters.name: Ask the AI
parameters.default: Write a two-line poem about a home server.
parameters.description: AI tests: what to ask each model. Costs a fraction of a penny per provider.

parameters.name: AI reply
parameters.description: AI tests: get a real reply, or only list the models the key can use
